title: HomeKit Weekly: Airversa’s Humelle is the Thread humidifier my house needs this winter
summary:

My nose ends up being super dry for months. A humidifier like the Airversa Humelle works with Apple Home over Thread, so it can run itself based on what the air actually needs, and with the temps in my area getting into the 40s in the next week, I am glad I have one.
